Contribute

Support the Network

Practical, high-impact contributions that strengthen decentralization and security.

Mine

Mining ensures the safety of the network and rewards you with XMR. Monero uses RandomX🛈, an ASIC-resistant algorithm developed by Monero contributors, which aims to remain mineable by consumer-grade hardware (CPUs).

  • Earn XMR while securing the network
  • No specialized hardware required
  • Convert CPU power into private income
Learn about mining

Run a node

An easy and effective way to help the Monero network is to run a node. Nodes keep the network safe and decentralized.

  • Validate blocks and broadcast transactions
  • Reduce reliance on third-party infrastructure
  • Enable others to connect if you open your node
